full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I need to buy some flowers for my wife .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Perhaps you'd be interested in red roses .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: What would the roses cost me ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: They're only $ 20 a dozen .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I like the sound of that .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes , that is today's sale price .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: A dozen will be fine .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Is there anything else you'd like to get ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: No , thank you .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: These roses should make your wife very happy .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Would you like to take a look at the menu , sir ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes . Thank you .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Would you care for a drink before you order ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: A glass of Qingdao beer .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Yes , sir . I'll bring it over . Have you decided what you'd like , sir ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Will you make some recommendation ?

frozen_references.claim: B orders a glass of Qingdao beer before the meal.
B is a customer preparing to order food at a restaurant.

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Have you heard what happened ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Heard what ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Deborah already had her baby .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I didn't know that .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I thought you knew .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I honestly didn't know .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: The baby was 8 pounds 6 ounces .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: That's good to hear .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Will you go and visit them ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Of course I will .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I just wanted to give you the good news .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Thanks for letting me know .

frozen_references.claim: B plans to visit Deborah and her new baby.

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: What dressing would you like on the salad ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: French dressing , please .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I beg your pardon ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Oh , French dressing .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Sorry , it's not available now.Anything else ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: We still prefer French dressing .

frozen_references.claim: B prefers French dressing for the salad.

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: John , my father isn't there at all . Are you kidding ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Cool , fellow , what's the date today , buddy ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: It's ... oh it's the 1st April , April Fool's Day .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: You forgot all of about it , didn't you ?

frozen_references.claim: B has played an April Fool's joke on A about A's father's presence.

review_rows.claim: B made an April Fool's joke to A (on April 1st), which A initially questioned

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: My friend Jean is very beautiful .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: What's her figure ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Perfect , and I like her charming eyes too .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: What's the color of her eyes ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Dark blue .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I give up ! I simply can't learn French !

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Why do you say that ? I think you're making a lot of progress .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: No , I'm not . I try and try and I still can't speak it very well .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Learning any language takes a lot of effort.But don't give up . Why don't we practise those dialogues together ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Good idea . That might help .

frozen_references.claim: B proposes practising French dialogues together with A, and A accepts.
